title: Neon Circles Portrait
description: A young boy with a serious expression stares directly forward, his face covered in vibrant, overlapping neon circles in pink, blue, green, and purple. The grayscale portrait is surrounded by dark, smoky, swirling patterns with faint colorful digital artifacts and text fragments floating in the background.
prompt: A close-up portrait of a young boy with short dark hair and a solemn expression, wearing a dark hooded garment. His face is covered with overlapping bright neon circles in pink, blue, green and purple. The background consists of dark smoky swirling textures with faint colorful digital glitches and text fragments. Moody contrast between grayscale elements and vibrant neon accents, surreal digital art style.
